say:3:1423467001:1.text: You're the ones Ravion sent to help, right?
say:3:1423467001:1.source_cn: 你们就是沙利叶大人说的来帮忙的人吧！

say:4:1423467002:1.text: Didn't think building a tourist route would be this hard!
say:4:1423467002:1.source_cn: 没想到这观光项目的开发难度有点大呀！

say:6:1423467004:1.text: Everyone's all about taking photos at scenic spots lately! Helthor's temple would be a huge draw.
say:6:1423467004:1.source_cn: 现在外面最流行的就是在观光点留念了！赫托老爷子的神殿肯...

say:7:1423467005:1.text: But the place is crawling with beasts. I can still hear them howling! If something happens, who's going to take the responsibility?
say:7:1423467005:1.source_cn: 可这神殿附近的野兽也太多了，我现在都能听到它们的嚎叫！...

say:8:1423467006:1.text: And one site isn't enough anyway. I've heard there are plenty of Helthor statues out near the royal city. The dwarves would love those...
say:8:1423467006:1.source_cn: 而且一个观光点也是不够的！我听说王城野外有不少赫托老爷...

say:9:1423467007:1.text: I wanted to find the statue ruins myself, but... I don't really know my way around! Everything looks the same out there. I got hopelessly lost!
say:9:1423467007:1.source_cn: 我本来想自己找雕像遗迹的位置，可是我……我不太认得路！...

say:10:1423467008:1.text: Could you help me mark where the statue ruins are? There are lots of them scattered around. Just help me find three and that'll be enough!
say:10:1423467008:1.source_cn: 你们能帮我找找雕像遗迹的位置，做些路标吗？老爷子的雕像...

say:11:1423467009:1.text: So we need to <style="highlight">clear the beasts near the Temple of Helthor</style> and <style="highlight">mark the locations of three Helthor statues...</style>

say:12:1423467010:1.text: Alright, one task at a time!
